title: Fynkel user settings
description: One `settings.json` per user under the platform's application-support directory (blueprint §19.2d item 12): audio bus gains, the quality profile and input rebinds. The Rust `fynkel.Settings` record's fields plus `input.rebinds`; a game reads it at startup through the Dart `Settings` service and writes it on change.

formatVersion.description: The settings format; `fynkel migrate` does not touch settings files, a game reads an older one with defaults for what it lacks.

muted.description: Every bus silent; the volumes are kept.

quality.description: A quality profile name from the project file; empty means the project's default profile.

input.description: Input rebinds: an action's bindings here replace the project file's for this user; an action absent here keeps the project's.
